about.description: Hello, I graduated in Computer Programming from Marmara University. I did my internship at Lits Consulting in Istanbul. I've loved programming since childhood. I work on projects and share them on Github.
about.quote: I care about performance, security and writing clean, readable code.

experience.nav_header: The progress I've made up to this point

descriptions.1: I gained experience in OOP, ALV, SQL queries, Adobe Forms and debugging.
descriptions.2: During the internship, I kept my focus on writing clean code and successfully finished two projects.
descriptions.3: I used classes and data tables in my projects. I wrote comprehensive SQL queries by establishing relationships between multiple tables.

projects.description: My projects are mostly made with React, Next.js, Express.js, and Tailwind CSS. I enjoy building web applications that are both functional and visually appealing.

newtod.title: TO-DO App
newtod.description: A To-do application that allows you to add tabs and tasks, and drag and drop them into your timeline. A weekly activities chart is also implemented. The application features dark and light modes, an auto-translation feature, and responsive design.

carRent.title: Car Rent App
carRent.description: Client-side powered by ReactJS, backend by ExpressJS in Turborepo. The car rental app includes a content management system for seamless customization.

socialMedia.title: Social Media App
socialMedia.description: A well-founded platform, this social media app empowers users to share posts, express appreciation through likes, and craft their own digital realms.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.description: Utilizing the robust combination of Next.js and Tailwind CSS, this personal portfolio showcases an array of meticulously crafted services and projects.

landingPage.title: Landing Page
landingPage.description: A business website that stands out with our customizable options. Built with React and Tailwindcss, our platform ensures seamless navigation and functionality across home, pricing, about, terms and contact pages.
